content: {"episode_id":"ep-05028","cpt":"93229","denial_carc":"CO-197","necessity_paragraph":"We appeal the CO-197 denial of mobile cardiac telemetry (CPT 93229), acknowledging that prior authorization was missing. The clinical indication note documents recurrent palpitations and a recent history of syncope, prompting a need for continuous rhythm monitoring to characterize the underlying cardiac arrhythmia. Mobile cardiac telemetry was ordered to capture the electrocardiographic correlates of these symptomatic events and guide further management of the unspecified arrhythmia."}
